notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
This update includes:

- Doubled game's brightness.

- Made subtle changes to the map to make it easier to navigate.

- Fixed the "Catrasca" achievement so it can be unlocked at any given night.

- Improved cuises' hitbox.

- Added a minimap with hints.

- Improved the broken fence's hitbox.

- Added notes to make the gameplay more intuitive.

Thank you very much for all the support! We'll continue to work on new updates and constantly improve the Pomberito experience based on your feedback!
